custom_news.source: Manchester Evening News / Enzo Maresca Press Conference
custom_news.headline: Nico O'Reilly not 100 percent and needs rest over international break
custom_news.text: Enzo Maresca has stated that Nico O'Reilly must utilize the coming weeks to return to peak fitness. Having withdrawn from the Coventry City match with a back problem, the 21-year-old has failed to start consecutive matches since. 'He's not 100 percent. In the last game I really liked him... [A rest is] what he needs, also to use that break to do the right things in terms of therapy and be 100 percent after the international break.'
